items.summary: CodeQL default setup skips PRs that change only requirements.txt, so the required check Analyze (python) never reports and every Dependabot PR stays BLOCKED until merged with --admin or the required check is changed.

A Dependabot group PR can pin a version below the one a single-package PR just fixed (PR #21 pinned certifi 2026.10.18 after #22 shipped 2026.10.19), so read every group diff for downgrades before merging.

backend/config/settings.py stats .env at import and the session sandbox denies it, so run pytest on a copy without .env, using config.toml.example with dummy values for every $VAR it declares and BASE_DIR set to the copy root.
Inside the session sandbox gh and pip fail with TLS OSStatus -26276, so GitHub API and PyPI calls must run outside the sandbox.
